do: Do not rely on cancellation to dedupe; one invalidation per burst; keep maxURLLength set in client.tsx.

text: Adding NOT NULL to an existing column takes two releases: first a migration that sets the default and backfills while the column stays nullable, then NOT NULL in a later release. Write column changes with the Schema builder (`Schema::table(...)->...->change()`, a reversible `->change()` in down()), not raw ALTER statements.
author: bohdantanasov
why: `.docker/init-app.sh` runs `php artisan migrate` during a rolling deploy, so the old code still running can write null and break a NOT NULL added in the same release; on platform-opportunities#124 a one-step raw-ALTER migration with a full null backfill was split this way (NOT NULL moved to release D25).
do: Split any NOT NULL tightening into a default/backfill migration now and the constraint in the next release; use Schema::table()->change(), not DB::statement ALTER.

text: The shared Card's `open` prop falls back to its internal `localOpen` (which defaults to false) as soon as the external condition driving `open` becomes false again, so any consumer that only sets `open=true` while some transient condition (like an error) holds will see the card auto-close the instant that condition clears.
author: bohdantanasov
why: Before the fix the card was driven `open` only while the error was active and then fell back to `localOpen` = false (packages/components/src/card/card.tsx:79-80), so it closed again once the error disappeared.
do: When controlling Card's open state from a transient condition, keep a persistent local boolean (set true by the event, never auto-reset) and pass that as `open`/`onOpenChange` instead of deriving `open` directly from the transient condition.
